name: schegent
description: Autonomously orchestrates the Claude Code CLI to drive the Speckit spec-driven development pipeline.

commands.title: Schegent: Resume Paused or Failed Workflow
Schegent: Re-detect Claude CLI prompt transport

schegent.cli.path.description: Path to the Claude CLI binary.

schegent.backend.runner.description: Backend runner used to drive each phase invocation. `claude` (default) spawns the Claude CLI (`schegent.cli.path`). `codex` spawns the Codex CLI in single-shot `exec --no-stream` mode; the prompt is piped over stdin. Existing workspaces see no behavior change. See docs/operations/backends.md for the contract any backend must honor.

schegent.loop.maxIterations.description: Maximum iterations for the Clarify and Analyze loop phases before force-advancing.

schegent.watchdog.pollIntervalMinutes.description: Credit watchdog poll interval in minutes.

schegent.invocation.timeoutSeconds.description: Per-phase CLI invocation timeout in seconds.

schegent.audit.rotation.sizeMB.description: Audit log rotation threshold in megabytes.

schegent.audit.rotation.maxAgeDays.description: Audit log rotation max age in days.

schegent.rules.injectPerPhase.description: Optionally write phase-specific rule files (.claude/rules/<phase>.md) before each invocation.

schegent.models.markdownDescription: List of custom model identifiers (e.g. `claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219`, `sonnet`, `opus`) available in the Pipeline Builder.

schegent.phases.markdownDescription: Custom phase definitions. Each phase is a reusable named Claude CLI invocation step. User-defined phases with the same `id` as a built-in phase **shadow** the built-in (replace it). Built-in phase ids are reserved: `specify`, `clarify`, `plan`, `tasks`, `analyze`, `implement`, `finalize`, `done`.

name.markdownDescription: Display name shown in sidebar tiles, audit logs, and the pipeline picker.

instruction.markdownDescription: Phase-specific directive injected into the Claude CLI prompt.

model.markdownDescription: Optional Claude model id passed as `--model <id>` to the CLI for this phase only.

effort.markdownDescription: Optional reasoning effort level passed as `--effort <level>` to the CLI for this phase only.

timeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Optional per-phase timeout in seconds (1 to 3600).

loopable.markdownDescription: When `true`, the phase re-runs until its stdout signals `[SCHEGENT_STATUS: CLEAR]`.

retryCondition.markdownDescription: Optional retry-condition DSL expression. When set AND the phase invocation produces a well-formed audit-log block, the expression is evaluated against the audit-entry's `metrics` map (extracted from `<identifier>: <number>` lines inside the SCHEGENT AUDIT LOG block). A truthy result loops the phase; a falsy result advances. The DSL supports identifiers (`[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*`, case-sensitive), signed numeric literals, comparison operators (`>`, `>=`, `<`, `<=`, `==`, `!=`), boolean combinators (`and` / `or` / `&&` / `||`), unary negation (`not` / `!`), and parentheses. Operator precedence (highest to lowest): `not`/`!` > comparisons > `and`/`&&` > `or`/`||`. Arithmetic, function calls, and member access are NOT supported. Invalid expressions are stripped at configuration load with a one-shot host-logger warning; the surrounding phase remains loadable and falls back to default loop semantics. Examples: `"open_questions > 0"`, `"unresolved_findings > 0 or open_questions > 0"`, `"not (confidence > 0.85)"`.

schegent.pipelines.markdownDescription: Custom pipeline definitions. A pipeline is an ordered chain of phase ids. The id `speckit-new-feature` is reserved for the built-in pipeline.

name.markdownDescription: Display name shown in the QuickPick picker and the sidebar header.

phases.markdownDescription: Ordered list of phase ids. Each id must match a built-in phase id or a `schegent.phases[].id` you defined.

schegent.defaultPipelineId.markdownDescription: Pipeline id used when a feature is enqueued without an explicit selection. Defaults to the built-in `speckit-new-feature` pipeline.

schegent.retry.maxAttempts.markdownDescription: Maximum delayed-retry attempts per run before pausing the queue. When a phase encounters a transient error or rate limit, it schedules a delayed retry. After this many consecutive failures without a clean recovery, the run and queue are paused. Range: 1–5. Feature 056 reduced the advertised max from 20 to match the effective implementation cap (`DELAYED_RETRY_CAP = 5`).

schegent.queue.globalConcurrencyCap.markdownDescription: Maximum number of workflow runs that may be in-flight at the same time. v1 supports exactly one active run; this knob is pinned at 1 for forward-compatibility. Values >1 saved by older versions are clamped on read. Range: 1–1.

schegent.logging.verbose.markdownDescription: When enabled, every Claude CLI invocation is spawned with `--debug-file`, `--output-format stream-json`, and `--verbose` flags. CLI streams are captured under `<workspaceRoot>/.schegent/sessions/<runId>/diagnostics/<pipelineId>/<phaseId>/iter-<N>/` (`debug.json`, `stream.jsonl`, `verbose.log`). Diagnostic files are **unredacted** and gitignored. Toggle off to return to standard headless mode. Toggling mid-run applies to the next phase invocation only — prior invocations are not re-captured. Setting changes are read at every phase invocation, so no extension reload is required.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogLevel.description: Runtime debug log severity filter. Records at or above the configured level are appended to the runtime log file; lower-severity records are dropped. Independent of `schegent.logging.verbose` (which controls the unredacted diagnostic sink). Re-read on every emit — mid-run changes apply at the next event boundary.
schegent.logging.runtimeLogLevel.markdownDescription: Runtime debug log severity filter. Records at or above the configured level are appended to the runtime log file; lower-severity records are dropped. Independent of `schegent.logging.verbose` (which controls the unredacted diagnostic sink). Re-read on every emit — mid-run changes apply at the next event boundary.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogFilePath.description: Runtime debug log file path. Empty string resolves to `<workspaceRoot>/.schegent/syslog`. Accepts an absolute path (POSIX or Windows) or a workspace-relative path. Relative paths containing `..` are rejected. The parent directory is auto-created on first write; the file is created with mode 0644 on POSIX.
schegent.logging.runtimeLogFilePath.markdownDescription: Runtime debug log file path. Empty string resolves to `<workspaceRoot>/.schegent/syslog`. Accepts an absolute path (POSIX or Windows) or a workspace-relative path. Relative paths containing `..` are rejected. The parent directory is auto-created on first write; the file is created with mode `0644` on POSIX.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogMaxBytes.markdownDescription: Maximum size in bytes of the active runtime log file before rotation. When the next write would push the file past this size, the current file is rotated to `<path>.1` and existing generations shift by one (`.1` → `.2`, ...). Range: 64 KiB–1 GiB. Default: 5 MiB. Setting changes are read on every log emit, so no extension reload is required.

schegent.logging.runtimeLogMaxGeneration.markdownDescription: Number of rotated runtime log generations to keep (`<path>.1` ... `<path>.N`). Older generations are deleted on the next rotation. Range: 0–20. Default: 3. Setting changes are read on every log emit.

schegent.fatalSignatures.markdownDescription: Operator-additive supplement to the code-resident Fatal Signature Registry. Each element is a verbatim substring; when present in CLI stdout or stderr, the active phase fails fast on the current invocation. Code-resident signatures are managed via PR review and cannot be removed or modified here. A malformed value falls back to `[]` without blocking extension activation.

schegent.claude.autoCompactPctOverride.markdownDescription: When set, the value is exported as `CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE` to the Claude Code CLI to override its auto-compaction threshold. Integer between 1 and 100 (percent). Leave unset to use the CLI default.

schegent.wakeUp.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable the Wake up background scheduler. When enabled, a per-user OS-native scheduled task (launchd on macOS, Task Scheduler on Windows, cron/systemd user units on Linux) periodically invokes a 1-token Claude CLI command in a sandboxed temporary directory to keep the 5-hour rolling allocation window warm. The OS entry is installed only on the **primary** VS Code host.

schegent.wakeUp.schedulerType.markdownDescription: Wake up scheduler trigger style. `chronological` fires once per day at a fixed local time (see `schegent.wakeUp.chronologicalTime`). `periodic` fires at a fixed interval (see `schegent.wakeUp.periodicInterval`).

schegent.wakeUp.chronologicalTime.markdownDescription: Daily fire time for Wake up in 24-hour `HH:MM` form (local time). Used only when `schegent.wakeUp.schedulerType` is `chronological`. Defaults to `04:00`.

schegent.wakeUp.periodicInterval.markdownDescription: Periodic fire interval for Wake up in `Every Nm` or `Every Nh` form. Minimum granularity is 1 minute (`Every 1m`). Intervals below 5 hours are accepted but surface a non-blocking advisory in the Settings UI because they may waste tokens within an unreset rolling window. Used only when `schegent.wakeUp.schedulerType` is `periodic`.
